content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same issue. I have an additional MQTT Web client successfully connecting to the Hive cluster, so I'm confident that my credentials are correct. Is it necessary to upload certificates for this process? I noticed that opening port 8080 involves certificate uploads. In a separate email, [company_name] sent me some certificates—could you explain their purpose?
The [product_name] uses its own certificates. Please consult the manual for further details.
[product_name] [version_no] only supports: • For AWS, Azure, and Alibaba Cloud integration, the connection is established via MQTT over TLS.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces DNS parsing difficulties when attempting to connect a [product_name] [version_no] device using MQTT. They note success with another MQTT client and raise questions about the need to upload certificates, especially after receiving certificate files from [company_name]. A response emphasizes that the device has its own certificates and clarifies the supported cloud connection methods. This creates ambiguity around certificate upload requirements and troubleshooting instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward advice on whether their setup requires certificate uploads, along with clarification on how to handle certificate files received from [company_name].
